context_requirements: Expression of SLC6A4 (serotonin transporter) and a functional serotonergic signalling context
Neuronal or enterochromaffin-like lineage; none of the nine tested lines are neuronal or express substantial SLC6A4
Presence of the annotated opioid receptor off-targets (OPRD1, OPRK1, OPRM1) at sufficient levels to mediate any transcriptional effect
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of SLC6A4-mediated transcriptional response despite the non-neuronal origin of the panel
